verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an incident-management platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes a hosted SaaS service: sign-up with a personalized web address and the 'PagerDuty Operations Cloud'. The local MCP server and the installable PagerDuty Agent are peripheral components, not the core product, so they earn no credit. No documented option exists to run PagerDuty itself on your own infrastructure.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
